source_identity.detail: Exact title, authors, arXiv version, and primary PDF reconciled.

coverage_manifest.detail: Manifest existed before SEA drafting and covers all substantive sections, 1 figure, 4 tables, 4 workflows, and Appendices A-C.

visual_reconciliation.detail: Figure 1 and Tables 1-4 represented as structured blocks; no load-bearing visual omitted.

quantitative_preservation.detail: Core estimator metrics; all Table 1 and Table 2 rows; Table 3 per-class metrics; Table 4 GPT effort sensitivity; adjusted costs and latency deltas preserved.

claims_vs_appraisal.detail: Reported findings are separated from independent appraisal, limitations, and implementation takeaways.

html_integrity.detail: Self-contained HTML; embedded CSS only; all TOC anchors resolve; no remote scripts/fonts/images.

internal_citation_syntax_scan.detail: No internal chat, web, or file-search citation markers appear in the HTML.

appraisal_timing.detail: Scores assigned only after source mapping, section condensation, and visual/table/workflow reconciliation.

primary_appraisal_boundary: Build-useful evidence for within-model pre-flight reasoning-budget allocation; exploratory cross-provider routing is not deployment-ready.
